Anna: Morning — quick async check for the day. Working on API gateway routing + rate-limit changes.
What I did: finished the route-matcher refactor and ran the smoke tests.
Blockers: noticed a small surge of 5xxs on /v1/embeddings after the matcher change; looks related to auth header rotation + a few upstream resets.
Today: planning a canary for the new routing policy + a tiny PR for rate-limiter tuning. Can folks watch the canary window? @Sam @Leo

Sam: saw a burst of 500s last night from a dedicated pool coldstart cluster; I bumped staging burst threshold and restarted a few nodes. Can you paste the logs you saw?

Anna: logs snippet: ```
ERROR auth: missing-kv-cache for token-rotate
ERROR upstream: connection_reset while dialing upstream-gateway
routes: matcher.v2 applied for request=/v1/embeddings
rate_limiter: drop=12 reason=burst_exceeded
```
Also saw several `drop=12` entries around the same time.

Marta: that `drop` pattern usually means token-bucket max_burst is too small after a spiky matcher change. Suggest bumping `max_burst` from 20 -> 50 for the canary and add a short cooldown. I can open a quick PR.

Leo: ack — I'm on rotation and can watch the canary at 11:30 PT. If we start seeing 429s I'll flip the fallback policy to `policy: legacy-route` and rollback the matcher.

Tara: quick ask — I left one comment on Anna's matcher PR about metric names (please use `router.pending_requests` instead of `router_waiting`). Also would be great to add a gauge for pending requests so we can correlate with drops.

Anna: thanks, adding the gauge now. PR link: https://git.redwood/test/PR-482 (opens shortly). I'll add a short dashboard panel for `router.pending_requests` + `rate_limiter.drop_count`.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-03-18T18:30Z — rollout plan 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 30m. Alerts will fire on 5xx > 1% or 429 > 3%.

Sam: FYI I've increased staging rate-limiter threshold to avoid noisy failures; will revert after canary pass. Pinging infra to keep an eye on dedicated pools.

Marta: opening PR #485: bump burst to 50, add unit test for token-bucket, add tiny changelog entry.

Anna: no other blockers from my side. Will coordinate the canary, post results here, and merge once metrics look stable. Thx everyone :thumbsup:
